errorMessage:
An inventory unit references a missing distribution center.
SELECT i.product_distribution_center_id, COUNT(*) AS affected_units
FROM `tv_thelook.inventory_items` AS i
LEFT JOIN `tv_thelook.distribution_centers` AS d ON d.id = i.product_distribution_center_id
WHERE i.created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-06 00:00:00+00'
  AND i.created_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-10-07 00:00:00+00'
  AND i.product_distribution_center_id IS NOT NULL
  AND d.id IS NULL
GROUP BY i.product_distribution_center_id
ORDER BY i.product_distribution_center_id
LIMIT 100
